name: Susumu Tokunaga
source: "Susumu Tokunaga, 30 years old, give or take. Looks younger, substitute teacher. Needs a strict framework to keep everything under control, including himself. Uncomfortable in affective and social relations, but if necessary, will pretend even if it may deceive others. Unstable as to his position in the world and detached from his family following a trauma. Narcissistic personality disorder, and handsome as a greek God!"
